newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT-Three IDB companies rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Three IDB companies rated buy.

text.p: Solid Financial Markets said in a report on Tuesday that it was assigning "buy" ratings to three companies belonging to Israel's IDB group and lowering a fourth to "market outperform".

Solid, a Tel Aviv-based broker, said it had initiated coverage of IDB Holdings, an investment company with diverse holdings, with a buy recommendation and a 12-month price target of 105-115 shekels against a current price of 81.56.
"Based on our analysis and on the net asset valuation (NAV) model, IDB Holdings is trading at a 36 percent discount to its net assets," Solid said.
Solid also initiated coverage of IDB Development, an IDB Holdings subsidiary, with a buy recommendation. It estimated the company was trading at a 37 percent discount to NAV.
Solid said it preferred IDB Development over IDB Holdings because of the latter's holding in Israel Discount Bank. Both companies are traded on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange.
PEC Israel Economic Corp, which is traded in New York, was rated a "strong buy" because it is trading at a 44 percent discount to NAV, Solid said.
Solid downgraded Discount Investment Corp to market outperform, noting it was trading 19 percent below NAV.
PEC is 71 percent owned by IDB Development while Discount Investment is 55 percent owned by IDB Development.
